clinical.q: Can I keep clinical notes and medical records?
clinical.a: Yes. For each visit, the treating doctor writes a record — reason for visit, relevant history, examination findings, assessment and plan, plus the specialty fields — saves it as a draft, finalizes it, and later adds dated addenda; the finalized text never changes. Only that doctor (and colleagues they explicitly share it with) can read it; owners and administrators see whether a visit is documented, not what it says. Prescriptions and attachments are not available yet, and the templates are pending review by practising clinicians.

specialties.q: Are there tools specific to dentistry, physiotherapy or ENT?
specialties.a: Yes, as a first version: a dental chart with treatment-plan items, physiotherapy assessments, sessions and discharge summaries, and ENT examination by region. Everything is written by the clinician — nothing is suggested or generated — and the tools are pending review by practising clinicians.

ai.q: Does raclinic include AI or diagnosis?
ai.a: No. Our line “Smart clinic management” is about organizing the clinic's daily work. raclinic does not diagnose, recommend treatments or write medical notes automatically.

branches.q: Does it suit a center with several specialties or branches?
branches.a: Yes. You can enable several specialties, choose which branches offer each one, and give every team member access to their own branches only.

ownership.q: Can I have a system of my own instead of a subscription?
ownership.a: You can request a custom project. Its scope, schedule, support and price are agreed separately for each project after a review of your needs.

data.q: Can I enter real patient data now?
data.a: No. This is a development version: please use test data only.

problems.title: Treatment over several visits
problems.body: Treatment spans visits, and remembering what is left of the plan is hard without one record.

problems.title: Different lengths per procedure

problems.body: What was found on a tooth and what was done to it? An answer that means leafing through old files.

problems.title: More than one dentist
problems.body: Each dentist has their own hours and days, and reception needs to see all of them.

problems.title: Patients returning for follow-up
problems.body: Follow-up visits need booking without clashing with new cases.

problems.title: The patient account

tools.body: Record the finding and the procedure performed per tooth and surface, in your own words; earlier findings are never overwritten.

faq.q: Does the chart support primary teeth?
faq.a: Yes. The chart supports permanent, primary and mixed dentition in FDI notation.

faq.q: Have dentists reviewed these tools?

security.metaDescription: How the raclinic workspace protects data: isolation between organizations, permissions, sessions and audit logs.
security.title: Security and data protection
security.lead: What the workspace does today to protect data, plainly and without claims.

sections.title: Isolation between organizations and branches
sections.body: All of an organization’s data belongs to it, and the server checks the organization and allowed branches on every request. Any id that is not yours is answered as if it did not exist.

sections.title: Permissions by role
sections.body: Each of the six roles has defined permissions enforced by the server; hiding buttons in the interface is not the protection.

sections.title: Clinical record privacy
sections.body: A visit record is read only by the treating doctor and colleagues they explicitly share it with for a set period, and every access is logged.

sections.title: Sign-in and sessions
sections.body: Passwords are stored as Argon2id hashes; sessions live on the server behind a secure cookie, with protection against cross-site requests, and end after a period of inactivity.

sections.title: Rate limits
sections.body: Sign-in, password recovery and public forms are rate limited, with counters shared between application servers.

sections.title: Audit logs
sections.body: Important administrative, financial and clinical actions, and platform operator actions, are recorded in logs that are never edited.

security.pendingBody: Hosting and data location, two-step verification and retention periods are not decided yet. We announce no certifications or compliance; this is a development version with demo data only.

privacy.metaDescription: What the raclinic website collects, why, and who sees it.
privacy.title: How this website handles your data
privacy.lead: A plain description of what the website collects today. A formal privacy policy has not been adopted yet.

sections.title: Contact and project forms
sections.body: When you send the “Contact us” or “Request a custom project” form, we store what you write: your name, how to reach you and your message, only to reply to you. Do not include patient information.

sections.title: Who sees your message
sections.body: Only authorized raclinic platform operators. Contact details are partly masked, and revealing them in full is recorded in the platform audit.

sections.title: Cookies and storage
sections.body: We use no tracking, analytics or advertising tools. A session cookie is used only after you sign in, and your chosen language is kept in your browser.

sections.title: Email
sections.body: The website sends no automatic email when your message arrives; we reply by hand.

sections.title: Retention
sections.body: How long messages and requests are kept is not decided yet; until it is, records are kept.

privacy.pendingTitle: A formal policy before commercial launch
privacy.pendingBody: A formal privacy policy will be published before raclinic is commercially available or real patient data is used.

support.title: Help & support
support.subtitle: Answers to common questions, and requests to the raclinic team.
support.faqLabel: Static help written by the raclinic team — not an AI assistant. It does not answer medical questions.
support.faqNone: No question matches. You can send a support request below.

faq.q: How do I add a team member?
faq.a: Owners and admins open Team, then add someone who already has an account, or invite an email address. Invitations are valid for 7 days.

faq.q: I forgot my password.
faq.a: On the sign-in page choose “Forgot your password?”. If email sending is set up, you receive a link that works once, for one hour. Choosing a new password signs you out everywhere.

faq.q: Why can't other doctors read my visit records?
faq.a: Clinical records are visible only to the treating doctor. To let a colleague cover, share them under Clinical coverage for a limited time; every access is recorded.

faq.q: Is the invoice a tax invoice?
faq.a: No. Invoices and receipts are ordinary documents. Tax invoices and electronic invoicing are not available.

faq.q: What does “Development grant” mean on the subscription page?
faq.a: Free access granted by raclinic for development, pilots or demonstrations. It is not a commercial subscription and no payment is involved.

faq.q: Can I send patient information in a support request?
faq.a: No. Please describe the problem without names, phone numbers or any medical details. The raclinic team cannot open patient records.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.subtitle: The organization's ledger, journal entries and statements
accounting.notSetUp: Accounting is not set up for this organization yet.
accounting.setupIntro: This creates a starter chart of accounts and automatic posting rules. From the start date, invoices, receipts, credit notes and refunds post automatically as balanced entries. Earlier balances come in as an opening entry.
accounting.templateNotice: The chart of accounts and posting rules are a starter implementation template that the clinic's accountant must review before real use. The system issues no certified statements or tax returns.
accounting.prerequisites: An owner must first choose the organization's currency (on the finance page) and time zone (in settings).
accounting.ownerSetsUp: The organization's owner sets up accounting.
accounting.cutoverHint: Preferably the first day of a month. Events before it are not posted automatically.
accounting.requireCashSession: Require cashiers to open a session before taking cash
accounting.branchScopeNotice: Full ledger views need access to all branches. You can follow receivables aging, periods and cash for your branches.
accounting.reconciliationIntro: Compares each ledger balance with the open documents. A difference means a missing opening balance or a posting problem.
accounting.migrationIntro: Patient balances at the start of {{date}}, computed from {{invoices}} earlier invoices and {{receipts}} receipts. Nothing is posted yet; review the amounts, then post them as an opening entry.
accounting.migrationNothing: There are no patient balances before the start date.
accounting.accrualNotice: Accrual basis: revenue is recognized when an invoice is issued, and money received stays a patient advance until allocated, so receipts are never counted as revenue twice. One currency per organization, no exchange differences.
accounting.journalSubtitle: Every movement is a balanced entry that is never edited; corrections are linked reversals
accounting.controlAccountsNote: Receivables, advances, payables and stock change only through their documents (or in the opening entry).
accounting.openingDateHint: Opening entries are dated on the ledger start ({{date}}).
accounting.reverseIntro: A new entry with the same lines and debits and credits swapped is posted; the original stays as it is.
accounting.documentPostingNote: This entry comes from a document (invoice, receipt or session) and is corrected through that document: a credit note, a receipt reversal or a refund.
accounting.codeHint: 3 to 8 digits, unique in the chart.
accounting.reportsSubtitle: From posted entries only, within a bounded period
accounting.signNote: Balances are signed as debit − credit.
accounting.resultNote: Income minus expenses as posted. Not a certified net profit: depreciation, taxes and accountant adjustments are not included.
accounting.accumulatedResult: Accumulated result (not yet closed to equity)
accounting.truncated: Too many results; narrow the period.
accounting.periodsSubtitle: Closing months in order blocks any posting into them
accounting.reopenIntro: Only the owner can reopen the latest closed month, with a reason. It is recorded in the period history and the audit log.
